verdict.rationale: Self-hosting rendezvous or relay servers is a fair question for a remote-access product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises relay or broker option for TeamViewer. Community posts only mention users looking for self-hosted alternatives, which is not evidence about TeamViewer's own capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
